title: Equality and iso-duality of Generalized Geometric Goppa codes
summary: Geometric Goppa codes are constructed by evaluating elements of an algebraic function field at the places of degree one. Extending this, generalized geometric Goppa codes were defined in [XNL99] and [Hey02] by allowing evaluation at places of arbitrary degree. In this paper, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for equality of generalized geometric Goppa codes, following the approach of [MP93].
